headline: Adopted consent agenda, approved entertainment permits, adopted Latin American cultural festival resolution, and referred trespass ordinance to committee
summary: The council went into executive session on potential litigation settlement and held a public forum. It adopted a consent agenda including tobacco license renewals, meeting minutes, an airport contract, and VTrans road standards. The council approved several entertainment permits, adopted a resolution recognizing Burlington's Latin American community, approved Aging Council appointments, and referred a trespass ordinance to the Ordinance Committee. The council also held work sessions on Act 181 Tier 1A application, community safety, City Circle, and Burlington Forward updates.
decisions: Adopted the consent agenda, including the accountability list, tobacco license renewals, meeting minutes, the airport contract, trustee resignation, communications, and VTrans road standards.
Approved the two-day special event outdoor entertainment permit for Oktoberfest Burlington LLC, 377 Pine Street, September 18-19, 2026.
Approved the one-day special event outdoor entertainment permit for Mojo Burlington, Waterfront Park, September 26th, 2 pm - 10 pm.
Approved the 2026-2027 Indoor Entertainment Permit Application for Jamaican Taste, 177 Church Street.
Approved the 2026-2027 Indoor Entertainment Permit Application for Community of Sound Corp, 1 Main Street (Box 14).
Adopted the resolution recognizing the contributions of Burlington's Latin American community and supporting cultural festivals.
Approved the recommended appointees for the Aging Council for Fiscal Year 2027.
Waived the first reading and referred the trespass ordinance (BCO Chapter 21, Sec. 21-45A(F)(3)) to the Ordinance Committee.
